comparator.name: Theology
comparator.sourceNotes: Permitted revisit on 2026-11-13. The current 2026–2027 study guide is byte-identical to the prior reviewed copy. A newly inspected public regulations index links the current adopted Studentenstatuut en OER 2026–2027 v1.3, effective 1 September 2026. Appendix 2(g), p45, explicitly covers cohort 2026 and allocates 60/60/60 EC, including the 10 EC thesis (5+5 in Year 3), 2.5 EC PPV at degree end and two integration-credit allocations of 1 EC. This closes the prior missing third-year/aggregate-credit question. Its Greek row assigns 12.5/2.5/2.5 EC by year rather than importing Greek 4 twice from the guide; Hebrew allocates 7.5/7.5/2.5 EC. The row label lists Hebrew 1–6 while seven positive credit cells are printed; preserve the formal allocations without inventing revised child course numbers. Ordinary full theological study remains the neutral route, without prior Greek or the optional Bible Translation route. The optional replacement minor is not added to that full theological pathway. OER Article 8(9) requires prior approval for external electives/minor. Current incoming TUA minor packages are not evidence of which ordinary-bachelor units an outgoing 30 EC minor replaces. Current OER Articles 8(7), 15 and 23 delegate module entry/assessment details to the guide and require a 10 EC thesis. The guide p92 still names Methodologie BT1 and completed relevant-field modules as thesis prerequisites; the current first year instead lists Academic Skills. The linked June 2015 thesis regulations describe writing and supervision and refer scope/conditions back to the guide, without an explicit 2026 correspondence or waiver. These remaining course/progression questions preclude certifying the complete applicable pathway. The first-year ten components remain verified at 60 EC, with Academic Skills before later written work, cumulative language prerequisites and 75% attendance. All 64 interest judgments and actual course research are retained. The strengthened internal 24-course humanities/psychology attempt is research pending the remaining external gate, not an approved comparison or no-match.
